scope: Identity of the locally prepared frozen release used for this analysis; not a verified identity claim about a remote Zenodo download.
hash_scope: Unchanged video/signal identities are inherited from the execution snapshot. Current metadata/package hashes incorporate the explicitly recorded metadata-only amendment when present; no full dataset rehash was performed. This sanitized JSON is not byte-identical to the internal execution manifest.

remote_identity.outcome: The recorded remote API request returned HTTP500. The remote record contents and downloadable bytes have not been verified against this local snapshot.

release_verification.scope: Use the existing release-builder verification workflow for the trusted downloaded release. This does not establish that an unavailable remote record is byte-identical to the local prepared snapshot.

declared_exceptions.description: Recruitment, consent and ethics approval, acquisition procedures, and original selection or quality-control history are documented from retained study records; these historical claims are not regenerated from the distributed files.
The consented original example and additional control transformations use original study images. The released keep-ratio 0.02 example uses the actual distributed BFDT video.

Original gallery images and keep-ratio 1.0, 0.30 and 0.10 control probes require custodian access to original recordings. The keep-ratio 0.02 probe uses the actual distributed BFDT video. Only aggregate privacy results are public.

Matched original-video training and testing arms are explicit controls, separate from the primary benchmark on released BFDT videos. Original-video access is required to regenerate these control arms.

External contact waveforms, videos and fixed external-trained weights follow their respective access terms. The public release-based benchmark does not imply that every external weight has a public download.

excluded_from_template: Host absolute paths, manuscript paths/hashes, private participant identifiers or mappings, and private exception-register paths are omitted.

metadata_amendment.rule: 0 remains 0; positive values become 1; missingness preserved
metadata_amendment.scope: metadata only; no video, signal, split or evaluation-protocol changes
